'''Delrakkins''' were lizard-like humanoids indigenous to the mountainous planet [[Delrakkin/Legends|Delrakkin]]. Most Delrakkin built their dwellings underground, although a group living above ground founded [[Delrakkin City]]. The planet was subjugated by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], who forced all Delrakkins to live underground. The Empire planned to make the entire planet into a test site, and gave the Delrakkins poisoned [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] in an attempt to eliminate them. However, the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] intervened and drove the Empire elsewhere, saving the Delrakkins.
